scene: An empty weathered vineyard shelter overlooks neglected vines and distant hill country at blue dawn.
verses: And the daughter of Zion is left as a cottage in a vineyard, as a lodge in a garden of cucumbers, as a besieged city.
alt: Imagined scene: A weathered vineyard shelter overlooks neglected vines at dawn.

scene: A rocky ascending path approaches a high mountain beneath a broad clear morning sky.
verses: And it shall come to pass in the last days, that the mountain of the Lord's house shall be established in the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.
alt: Imagined scene: A rocky path climbs toward a high mountain beneath a clear sky.

scene: Ancient bronze anklets, simple rings, bracelets and a folded veil lie on a low stone shelf.
verses: In that day the Lord will take away the bravery of their tinkling ornaments about their feet, and their cauls, and their round tires like the moon,
The chains, and the bracelets, and the mufflers,
The bonnets, and the ornaments of the legs, and the headbands, and the tablets, and the earrings,
The rings, and nose jewels,
The changeable suits of apparel, and the mantles, and the wimples, and the crisping pins,
The glasses, and the fine linen, and the hoods, and the vails.
alt: Imagined scene: Bronze anklets, rings, bracelets and a folded veil rest on a stone shelf.

scene: A linen canopy provides shade and shelter beside a stone wall during passing rain.
verses: And there shall be a tabernacle for a shadow in the day time from the heat, and for a place of refuge, and for a covert from storm and from rain.
alt: Imagined scene: A linen canopy offers shelter beside a stone wall in passing rain.

scene: An empty hillside vineyard contains a stone watchtower and a carved rock winepress.
verses: And he fenced it, and gathered out the stones thereof, and planted it with the choicest vine, and built a tower in the midst of it, and also made a winepress therein: and he looked that it should bring forth grapes, and it brought forth wild grapes.
alt: Imagined scene: A stone watchtower and rock winepress stand in a hillside vineyard.

scene: A large unmarked parchment writing sheet and an ancient stylus rest on a plain wooden table.
verses: Moreover the Lord said unto me, Take thee a great roll, and write in it with a man's pen concerning Mahershalalhashbaz.
alt: Imagined scene: A large parchment sheet and a stylus rest on a wooden table.

scene: A broken wooden ox yoke and a snapped staff lie unused on a field path.
verses: For thou hast broken the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, as in the day of Midian.
alt: Imagined scene: A broken wooden yoke and snapped staff lie on a field path.

scene: An ancient iron axe and a simple bronze saw rest beside cut timber, without modern handles or teeth.
verses: Shall the axe boast itself against him that heweth therewith? or shall the saw magnify itself against him that shaketh it? as if the rod should shake itself against them that lift it up, or as if the staff should lift up itself, as if it were no wood.
alt: Imagined scene: An ancient axe and saw rest beside cut timber.

scene: A fresh green shoot grows from a weathered cut tree stump in soft daylight.
verses: And there shall come forth a rod out of the stem of Jesse, and a Branch shall grow out of his roots:
alt: Imagined scene: A fresh green shoot grows from a weathered tree stump.

scene: A clay water jar and rope sit beside a stone well filled with clear water.
verses: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.
alt: Imagined scene: A clay jar and rope sit beside a well of clear water.

scene: Broken mudbrick walls and empty ruined dwellings stand beneath a stark desert sky.
verses: And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees' excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.
It shall never be inhabited, neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation: neither shall the Arabian pitch tent there; neither shall the shepherds make their fold there.
But wild beasts of the desert shall lie there; and their houses shall be full of doleful creatures; and owls shall dwell there, and satyrs shall dance there.
And the wild beasts of the islands shall cry in their desolate houses, and dragons in their pleasant palaces: and her time is near to come, and her days shall not be prolonged.
alt: Imagined scene: Broken walls and ruined dwellings stand beneath a desert sky.

scene: A broken wooden royal staff lies on a plain stone floor beside an empty seat.
verses: The Lord hath broken the staff of the wicked, and the sceptre of the rulers.
alt: Imagined scene: A broken royal staff lies beside an empty seat.

scene: A drying streambed winds between withered reeds and brown grass in the ancient Near East.
verses: For the waters of Nimrim shall be desolate: for the hay is withered away, the grass faileth, there is no green thing.
alt: Imagined scene: A drying streambed winds between withered reeds and grass.

scene: An abandoned grape-treading basin stands beside drooping vines and a silent vineyard.
verses: For the fields of Heshbon languish, and the vine of Sibmah: the lords of the heathen have broken down the principal plants thereof, they are come even unto Jazer, they wandered through the wilderness: her branches are stretched out, they are gone over the sea.
Therefore I will bewail with the weeping of Jazer the vine of Sibmah: I will water thee with my tears, O Heshbon, and Elealeh: for the shouting for thy summer fruits and for thy harvest is fallen.

And gladness is taken away, and joy out of the plentiful field; and in the vineyards there shall be no singing, neither shall there be shouting: the treaders shall tread out no wine in their presses; I have made their vintage shouting to cease.
alt: Imagined scene: An unused grape-treading basin stands beside drooping vines.

scene: Only a few ripe olives remain on the highest branches of an olive tree after harvest.
verses: Yet gleaning grapes shall be left in it, as the shaking of an olive tree, two or three berries in the top of the uppermost bough, four or five in the outmost fruitful branches thereof, saith the Lord God of Israel.
alt: Imagined scene: A few ripe olives remain on upper branches after harvest.

scene: Freshly pruned vine branches and cut tendrils lie below a grapevine before harvest.
verses: For afore the harvest, when the bud is perfect, and the sour grape is ripening in the flower, he shall both cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks, and take away and cut down the branches.
alt: Imagined scene: Cut branches and tendrils lie beneath a pruned grapevine.

scene: Linen fishing nets lie unused beside a broad shrinking river with drying reeds.
verses: And the waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall be wasted and dried up.
And they shall turn the rivers far away; and the brooks of defence shall be emptied and dried up: the reeds and flags shall wither.
The paper reeds by the brooks, by the mouth of the brooks, and every thing sown by the brooks, shall wither, be driven away, and be no more.
The fishers also shall mourn, and all they that cast angle into the brooks shall lament, and they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish.
alt: Imagined scene: Fishing nets lie beside a shrinking river and drying reeds.

scene: A rough sackcloth garment and a pair of simple leather sandals lie unused beside a stone doorway.
verses: At the same time spake the Lord by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, Go and loose the sackcloth from off thy loins, and put off thy shoe from thy foot. And he did so, walking naked and barefoot.
alt: Imagined scene: Sackcloth and leather sandals lie beside a stone doorway.

scene: An empty stone watchtower overlooks a wide desert road beneath a violet night sky.
verses: And he cried, A lion: My lord, I stand continually upon the watchtower in the daytime, and I am set in my ward whole nights:
alt: Imagined scene: A watchtower overlooks a desert road beneath a violet night sky.

scene: An open reservoir and water channel sit between old stone defensive walls in hill country.
verses: Ye have seen also the breaches of the city of David, that they are many: and ye gathered together the waters of the lower pool.
And ye have numbered the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses have ye broken down to fortify the wall.
Ye made also a ditch between the two walls for the water of the old pool: but ye have not looked unto the maker thereof, neither had respect unto him that fashioned it long ago.
alt: Imagined scene: A reservoir and water channel sit between old defensive walls.

scene: An ancient wooden trading ship with a square linen sail approaches an empty rocky Mediterranean harbor.
verses: The burden of Tyre. Howl, ye ships of Tarshish; for it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in: from the land of Chittim it is revealed to them.
alt: Imagined scene: A wooden trading ship approaches a rocky harbor.

scene: Withered vines frame a deserted damaged city gateway and an empty street.
verses: The new wine mourneth, the vine languisheth, all the merryhearted do sigh.
The mirth of tabrets ceaseth, the noise of them that rejoice endeth, the joy of the harp ceaseth.
They shall not drink wine with a song; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it.
The city of confusion is broken down: every house is shut up, that no man may come in.
There is a crying for wine in the streets; all joy is darkened, the mirth of the land is gone.
In the city is left desolation, and the gate is smitten with destruction.
alt: Imagined scene: Withered vines frame a damaged city gateway and empty street.

scene: Bread, bowls of rich food, fruit and a clay wine jug are laid on a table overlooking a mountain landscape.
verses: And in this mountain shall the Lord of hosts make unto all people a feast of fat things, a feast of wines on the lees, of fat things full of marrow, of wines on the lees well refined.
alt: Imagined scene: Bread, food, fruit and wine fill a table overlooking mountains.

scene: An open ancient city gate leads onto a level stone path in clear morning light.
verses: Open ye the gates, that the righteous nation which keepeth the truth may enter in.
The way of the just is uprightness: thou, most upright, dost weigh the path of the just.
alt: Imagined scene: An open city gate leads onto a level stone path.

scene: A cared-for green vineyard grows beside a clear irrigation channel at dawn.
verses: In that day sing ye unto her, A vineyard of red wine.
I the Lord do keep it; I will water it every moment: lest any hurt it, I will keep it night and day.
alt: Imagined scene: A green vineyard grows beside a clear water channel.

scene: A large dressed cornerstone rests securely at the base of an ancient stone wall under construction.
verses: Therefore thus saith the Lord God, Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner stone, a sure foundation: he that believeth shall not make haste.
alt: Imagined scene: A dressed cornerstone rests at the base of an unfinished wall.

scene: A rolled parchment secured with cord and a plain clay seal lies closed on a wooden table.
verses: And the vision of all is become unto you as the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one that is learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I cannot; for it is sealed:
alt: Imagined scene: A parchment roll lies closed with cord and a clay seal.

scene: Very finely crushed terracotta and tiny flat splinters lie beside an empty hearth in clear morning light.
verses: And he shall break it as the breaking of the potters' vessel that is broken in pieces; he shall not spare: so that there shall not be found in the bursting of it a sherd to take fire from the hearth, or to take water withal out of the pit.
alt: Imagined scene: Shattered jar fragments lie near an empty hearth.

scene: An empty ancient wooden chariot with simple spoked wheels stands beside the road, with no horses or people.
verses: Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help; and stay on horses, and trust in chariots, because they are many; and in horsemen, because they are very strong; but they look not unto the Holy One of Israel, neither seek the Lord!
alt: Imagined scene: An empty wooden chariot stands beside a road.

scene: A peaceful modest stone dwelling and shaded garden sit beneath green trees in quiet afternoon light.
verses: And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation, and in sure dwellings, and in quiet resting places;
alt: Imagined scene: A modest stone dwelling and shaded garden sit beneath green trees.

scene: A securely pitched linen tent with taut cords and firm wooden stakes stands beside a quiet stone terrace.
verses: Look upon Zion, the city of our solemnities: thine eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet habitation, a tabernacle that shall not be taken down; not one of the stakes thereof shall ever be removed, neither shall any of the cords thereof be broken.
alt: Imagined scene: A linen tent stands firmly secured with cords and stakes.

scene: Thorns and brambles grow through ruined ancient fortress walls beneath cool gray clouds.
verses: And thorns shall come up in her palaces, nettles and brambles in the fortresses thereof: and it shall be an habitation of dragons, and a court for owls.
alt: Imagined scene: Thorns and brambles grow through ruined fortress walls.

scene: Small wildflowers bloom across previously dry desert ground beneath distant rocky hills after rain.
verses: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.

It shall blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing: the glory of Lebanon shall be given unto it, the excellency of Carmel and Sharon, they shall see the glory of the Lord, and the excellency of our God.
alt: Imagined scene: Wildflowers bloom across dry desert ground after rain.

scene: An opened unmarked letter lies on a low stone ledge at a quiet sanctuary entrance.
verses: And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up unto the house of the Lord, and spread it before the Lord.
alt: Imagined scene: An opened letter lies at a quiet sanctuary entrance.

scene: Gold and silver vessels, spice jars and an oil flask fill shelves in an empty ancient treasury room.
verses: And Hezekiah was glad of them, and shewed them the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and all the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah shewed them not.
alt: Imagined scene: Metal vessels, spice jars and an oil flask fill a treasury.

scene: A small wildflower and green grass bend beside a patch of withered grass in a passing breeze.
verses: The voice said, Cry. And he said, What shall I cry? All flesh is grass, and all the goodliness thereof is as the flower of the field:
The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: because the spirit of the Lord bloweth upon it: surely the people is grass.
The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.
alt: Imagined scene: A small wildflower and grass bend beside withered ground.

scene: A clear pool and spring water nourish cedar and acacia trees in once dry stony country.
verses: I will open rivers in high places, and fountains in the midst of the valleys: I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.
I will plant in the wilderness the cedar, the shittah tree, and the myrtle, and the oil tree; I will set in the desert the fir tree, and the pine, and the box tree together:
alt: Imagined scene: A pool and spring water nourish trees in dry country.

scene: A bruised reed lies beside a small clay oil lamp whose wick glows faintly with a little smoke.
verses: A bruised reed shall he not break, and the smoking flax shall he not quench: he shall bring forth judgment unto truth.
alt: Imagined scene: A bruised reed lies beside a lamp with a faintly glowing wick.

scene: A clear stream crosses a newly open wilderness path between dry hills beneath a blue sky.
verses: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
alt: Imagined scene: A stream crosses a wilderness path between dry hills.

scene: Ancient iron tongs and a small hammer rest beside a stone anvil and a charcoal hearth, no people or idols.
verses: The smith with the tongs both worketh in the coals, and fashioneth it with hammers, and worketh it with the strength of his arms: yea, he is hungry, and his strength faileth: he drinketh no water, and is faint.
alt: Imagined scene: Iron tongs and a hammer rest beside a stone anvil and charcoal hearth.

scene: Broken bronze gate panels and snapped iron bars lie beside an empty stone entrance.
verses: I will go before thee, and make the crooked places straight: I will break in pieces the gates of brass, and cut in sunder the bars of iron:
alt: Imagined scene: Broken bronze gate panels and iron bars lie beside an entrance.

scene: Unworked gold and silver pieces rest on a balance scale beside ancient metalworking tools.
verses: They lavish gold out of the bag, and weigh silver in the balance, and hire a goldsmith; and he maketh it a god: they fall down, yea, they worship.
alt: Imagined scene: Gold and silver pieces rest on scales beside metalworking tools.

scene: A simple ancient hand mill and a bowl of flour sit on the floor of an empty stone courtyard.
verses: Take the millstones, and grind meal: uncover thy locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers.
alt: Imagined scene: A hand mill and flour sit in an empty courtyard.

scene: Fresh water flows from a cleft in a rock onto dry stony wilderness ground.
verses: And they thirsted not when he led them through the deserts: he caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them: he clave the rock also, and the waters gushed out.
alt: Imagined scene: Fresh water flows from a cleft rock onto dry ground.

scene: A raised level road passes between rugged mountains toward a bright horizon.
verses: And I will make all my mountains a way, and my highways shall be exalted.
alt: Imagined scene: A raised road passes between rugged mountains toward a bright horizon.

scene: A piece of dark flint rests on a flat stone in stark morning light.
verses: For the Lord God will help me; therefore shall I not be confounded: therefore have I set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be ashamed.
alt: Imagined scene: Dark flint rests on flat stone in morning light.

scene: A plain clay cup rests on bare stone in the shadow of a damaged city wall.
verses: Awake, awake, stand up, O Jerusalem, which hast drunk at the hand of the Lord the cup of his fury; thou hast drunken the dregs of the cup of trembling, and wrung them out.
alt: Imagined scene: A clay cup rests in the shadow of a damaged city wall.

scene: Loosened ancient neck shackles lie in dust beside an open stone gateway, with no people.
verses: Shake thyself from the dust; arise, and sit down, O Jerusalem: loose thyself from the bands of thy neck, O captive daughter of Zion.
alt: Imagined scene: Loosened neck shackles lie in dust beside an open gateway.

scene: A tender green plant takes root in dry cracked ground beside a weathered rock.
verses: For he shall grow up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of a dry ground: he hath no form nor comeliness; and when we shall see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.
alt: Imagined scene: A tender green plant grows in dry cracked ground.

scene: Blue, red and clear colored stones lie beside unfinished foundation blocks and a city gateway.
verses: O thou afflicted, tossed with tempest, and not comforted, behold, I will lay thy stones with fair colours, and lay thy foundations with sapphires.
And I will make thy windows of agates, and thy gates of carbuncles, and all thy borders of pleasant stones.
alt: Imagined scene: Colored stones lie beside unfinished foundations and a gateway.

scene: Fresh flatbread and clay jars of clear water stand on a plain table in an open empty courtyard.
verses: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.

Wherefore do ye spend money for that which is not bread? and your labour for that which satisfieth not? hearken diligently unto me, and eat ye that which is good, and let your soul delight itself in fatness.
alt: Imagined scene: Flatbread and water jars stand on a plain courtyard table.

scene: An open sanctuary entrance and a quiet empty courtyard welcome the morning light.
verses: Even them will I bring to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer: their burnt offerings and their sacrifices shall be accepted upon mine altar; for mine house shall be called an house of prayer for all people.
alt: Imagined scene: Morning light enters an open sanctuary courtyard.

scene: Loose stones have been cleared from a broad ancient footpath and piled to its side.
verses: And shall say, Cast ye up, cast ye up, prepare the way, take up the stumblingblock out of the way of my people.
alt: Imagined scene: Loose stones sit beside a cleared ancient footpath.

scene: Freshly broken flatbread and a folded simple garment wait on a low table by a modest doorway.
verses: Is it not to deal thy bread to the hungry, and that thou bring the poor that are cast out to thy house? when thou seest the naked, that thou cover him; and that thou hide not thyself from thine own flesh?
alt: Imagined scene: Broken bread and a folded garment wait by a modest doorway.

scene: A fragile spiderweb stretches across an empty broken window opening in a weathered stone wall.
verses: They hatch cockatrice' eggs, and weave the spider's web: he that eateth of their eggs dieth, and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper.
Their webs shall not become garments, neither shall they cover themselves with their works: their works are works of iniquity, and the act of violence is in their hands.
alt: Imagined scene: A fragile web stretches across a broken window opening.

scene: Wide ancient city gates stand open in full daylight, with an empty road beyond them.
verses: Therefore thy gates shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night; that men may bring unto thee the forces of the Gentiles, and that their kings may be brought.
alt: Imagined scene: Wide city gates stand open beside an empty road in daylight.

scene: A simple festive head wreath, a clay oil flask, and folded bright cloth rest beside rough sackcloth and ashes.
verses: To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the Lord, that he might be glorified.
alt: Imagined scene: A wreath, oil flask and bright cloth rest beside sackcloth and ashes.

scene: An empty watchtower rises above an ancient city wall beneath the first light before dawn.
verses: I have set watchmen upon thy walls, O Jerusalem, which shall never hold their peace day nor night: ye that make mention of the Lord, keep not silence,
alt: Imagined scene: A watchtower rises above a city wall before dawn.

scene: An empty stone grape-treading basin is stained deep red by crushed grapes beside a folded stained linen cloth, no people or blood.
verses: Wherefore art thou red in thine apparel, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winefat?

I have trodden the winepress alone; and of the people there was none with me: for I will tread them in mine anger, and trample them in my fury; and their blood shall be sprinkled upon my garments, and I will stain all my raiment.
alt: Imagined scene: Grape juice stains an empty winepress and folded linen cloth.

scene: A half-shaped clay vessel and damp clay rest on a simple ancient potter's work surface.
verses: But now, O Lord, thou art our father; we are the clay, and thou our potter; and we all are the work of thy hand.
alt: Imagined scene: A half-shaped clay vessel rests on a potter's work surface.

scene: New modest stone houses stand beside a flourishing vineyard in peaceful hill country.
verses: And they shall build houses, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.
alt: Imagined scene: Modest stone houses stand beside a flourishing vineyard.

scene: An empty plain wooden footstool rests on bare earth beneath a vast blue sky, a restrained visual metaphor.
verses: Thus saith the Lord, The heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool: where is the house that ye build unto me? and where is the place of my rest?
alt: Imagined scene: A plain wooden footstool rests beneath a vast blue sky.
